conflicts.fix: build commits at task boundaries and next --loop commits every tick with a Task: trailer. Run /blitz:build interactively and review before each commit, do not run next --loop, and skip /blitz:ship.

conflicts.description: User rule forbids automatic pushes to remote
conflicts.fix: next --loop pushes after every tick and ship pushes the release branch. Run the loop only in a session you watch, or drive build and check by hand and push manually.

conflicts.description: User rule forbids running tests or build scripts without explicit approval
conflicts.fix: tasks.sh verify, the Stop gate (gate.json) and check all execute verify[] commands unattended. Either relax the rule for the listed commands or stay off next --loop and run /blitz:check yourself.

conflicts.description: User rule requires a specific branch-naming convention
conflicts.fix: build --parallel worktrees branch as the platform names them; ship uses release/vX.Y.Z. Rename the branch before opening a PR, or run build without --parallel on your own branch.

conflicts.description: User rule forbids automatic branch creation
conflicts.fix: Only build --parallel (worktree isolation) and ship create branches. Use the default sequential /blitz:build, which works on the current branch.

conflicts.description: User rule requires all changes go through a pull request
conflicts.fix: ship merges the release branch back. Stop before its merge step and open a PR from the release branch instead; next --loop only prints Ready: /blitz:ship and never merges.

conflicts.description: User rule forbids automatic code fixes
conflicts.fix: Run /blitz:check without --fix (report only). next --loop row 3 dispatches check --fix, so do not run the loop unattended.

conflicts.description: User uses a non-npm package manager; blitz default commands use npm
conflicts.fix: Ensure package.json scripts work with your package manager and write verify[] commands with it (plan reads the packageManager field). Most skills invoke npm run <script>, which the pnpm/bun/yarn shims accept.

conflicts.description: User rule requires a specific commit message format
conflicts.fix: blitz writes conventional-commit subjects plus a Task: <slug>/T-nnn trailer; the trailer is load-bearing for check --scope plan and learn. Add your ticket reference to the subject or body, keep the trailer.

conflicts.description: User rule prefers cheaper models than blitz defaults
conflicts.fix: Every skill is model: inherit, so the session model wins. Set CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=sonnet to force subagents; critic --mode reject and ship pin opus and are the only exceptions.
